task.description: Design comprehensive test coverage for ADP-02 and align/augment existing tests. Produce/update test specs to verify additive tenant_id behavior on definition, instance, task, transition, and audit persistence paths; default-tenant compatibility; and cross-tenant isolation guarantees. Ensure tests map to acceptance criteria and include regression linkage for PD-01, PD-07, EE-01, and OBS-03.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec(s) explicitly trace ADP-02 acceptance criteria to concrete unit/integration tests
Cross-tenant leakage and default-tenant compatibility cases are both covered
Planned/updated tests are actionable for TEST-RUNNER without ambiguity

result.summary: Designed ADP-02 test coverage and augmented integration tests for tenant-scoped behavior on definition, instance, task, transition, and audit persistence, including default-tenant compatibility and regression traceability to PD-01, PD-07, EE-01, and OBS-03.
